item.text: {"action":"write","arguments_json":"{\"path\":\"work.py\",\"content\":\"\\\"\\\"\\\"Evaluate changes to declared source dependencies.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n\\nfrom __future__ import annotations\\n\\nimport json\\nfrom typing import Any, Mapping\\n\\n_MISSING = {\\\"kind\\\": \\\"missing\\\"}\\n\\n\\ndef _canonical_json(value: Any) -> str:\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Return a stable, type-sensitive representation of a JSON value.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    return json.dumps(\\n        value,\\n        sort_keys=True,\\n        separators=(\\\",\\\", \\\":\\\"),\\n        ensure_ascii=False,\\n        allow_nan=False,\\n    )\\n\\n\\ndef evaluate(request: Mapping[str, Any], policy: Mapping[str, Any]) -> dict[str, Any]:\\n    \\\"\\\"\\\"Evaluate complete states for relevant declared source paths.\\\"\\\"\\\"\\n    declared = request.get(\\\"declared\\\", ())\\n    ignored = set(policy.get(\\\"ignored\\\", ()))\\n    saved = request.get(\\\"saved\\\", {})\\n    current = request.get(\\\"current\\\", {})\\n\\n    changed = []\\n    for path in set(declared):\\n        if path in ignored:\\n            continue\\n        before = saved.get(path, _MISSING)\\n        after = current.get(path, _MISSING)\\n        if _canonical_json(before) != _canonical_json(after):\\n            changed.append(path)\\n\\n    changed.sort()\\n    return {\\\"needs_review\\\": bool(changed), \\\"changed\\\": changed}\\n\"}"}
